name: sendinput-win32

scripts.install: node -e "console.log('[sendinput_win32] skipping auto-build — run npm run rebuild:native from the project root on a Windows machine to compile.')"

_comment_build_script: The 'build' script above compiles against the SYSTEM Node ABI — useful only as a quick local compile-error check. It does NOT produce a binary Electron can load. Always use the root project's `npm run rebuild:native`, which invokes @electron/rebuild to target Electron's own bundled Node/V8 ABI instead.
